title: Bella the Bird Who Wouldn't Try Broccoli: The Green Tree!

lines.text: Dinner was served, and Bella the bluebird stared down at her plate with big eyes!
lines.caps: Dinner was *SERVED, | and Bella the bluebird stared down at her *PLATE | with big *EYES!

lines.text: Eww! Little green broccoli trees! I don't like green foods! she squawked!
lines.caps: *EWW! Little green broccoli *TREES! | I don't like green foods! she *SQUAWKED!

lines.text: Have you ever tasted one? asked her papa. No, but it looks weird! Bella replied!
lines.caps: Have you ever tasted *ONE? | asked her papa. No, but it looks *WEIRD! | Bella *REPLIED!

lines.text: Papa smiled and said, How do you know if a playground is fun before you slide?
lines.caps: Papa smiled and *SAID, | How do you know if a playground is *FUN | before you *SLIDE?

lines.text: Bella took a tiny fork, dipped the broccoli tree in melted cheese, and took a bite!
lines.caps: Bella took a tiny *FORK, | dipped the broccoli tree in melted *CHEESE, | and took a *BITE!

lines.text: CRUNCH! It was warm, savory, and super delicious like a crispy party!
lines.caps: *CRUNCH! It was warm, *SAVORY, | and super delicious like a crispy *PARTY!

lines.text: Broccoli gives your wings super flying power and strengthens your bones!
lines.caps: Broccoli gives your wings super *FLYING | power and strengthens your *BONES!

lines.text: Taking one brave bite can unlock your brand new favorite food!
lines.caps: Taking one brave *BITE | can unlock your brand *NEW | favorite *FOOD!
